rawContent: I am so proud to have the support of @queen_waterbury. Her bravery to stand up against the sexual exploitation she faced at the New York City Ballet moves the #metoo moment another step forward. Its time for the law to catch up to the reality of the world we live in. https://t.co/6Otm1pw0l9
When are you calling for a @TheJusticeDept civil rights investigation into the death of #GeorgeFloyd, @RepJerryNadler? #BlackLivesMatter #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd

What you should do, @RepJerryNadler is call for an immediate public hearing.  But you won’t because you don’t act, you just write strongly-worded letters. @TheJusticeDept will say they need “time” which means the @realDonaldTrump DOJ will do nothing whatsoever. #BlackLivesMatter

Meanwhile, Minneapolis burns.  Another black person is murdered in America.  And we will have letters. We will have requests, and we will have more injustice. #minneapolisriots #floydgeorge #BlackLivesMatter

We need an immediate @HouseJudiciary hearing on police brutality in America. We need a special prosecutor to investigate racial bias in police departments across our country. We need this now & it’s your job to do it @RepJerryNadler #BlackLivesMatter #JusticeForGeorgeFloyd

Earlier today we rallied against the injustice & violence our black community continues to face. Nothing I’ve seen or could fathom warrants running over crowds of people. Nothing could. #blacklivesmatter https://t.co/kdG4UcBBBy

Some people in politics are on the fence about showing up to rallies and protests. I’m firmly in the camp of showing up. It’s quite literally the least I can do.  This was me yesterday. Keep sending info on upcoming actions. I’ll be there whenever I can. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/vnGvpUJpta

Why can’t the @NYGovCuomo and the @NYCMayor show up at a peaceful protest here in New York City? They can express support for #blacklivesmatter while recognizing that the police have a role to play - one that must change.

On #Juneteenth, it's incredibly important we make it clear to our government that #blacklivesmatter. This is the moment to act. We need representatives who have the guts to address our history head-on.
